facts.statement: Trinisaura lived in what is now James Ross Island off the coast of northern Antarctica.
facts.quote: in what is now James Ross Island off the coast of northern Antarctica near Patagonia

facts.statement: Fossils of Trinisaura were collected in 2008 by Juan Moly and Rodolfo Coria from the Snow Hill Island Formation.
facts.quote: The fossils were collected in 2008 by paleontologists Juan Moly and Rodolfo Coria from the sandstone of the Snow Hill Island Formation

facts.statement: Trinisaura was formally described by Coria and colleagues in 2013 after remaining undescribed in the Museo de La Plata collections.
facts.quote: It remained undescribed in the collections of the Museo de La Plata until its description by Coria and colleagues in 2013

facts.statement: The genus name Trinisaura honors Argentine geologist Trinidad "Trini" Diaz and the Latin root for lizard.
facts.quote: The genus name is to commemorate the efforts of Argentine geologist Trinidad "Trini" Diaz and the Latin root -sauros, meaning "lizard".

facts.statement: The species name santamartaensis refers to Santa Marta Cove, the location where the fossils were found.
facts.quote: The species name is after Santa Marta Cove, where the fossils were collected.

facts.statement: Trinisaura is classified as a basal member of the ornithopod clade.
facts.quote: Trinisaura has been classified as a basal (early-diverging or "primitive") member of the clade Ornithopoda

facts.statement: The known skeleton of Trinisaura belongs to a subadult individual estimated to be 1.5 meters long.
facts.quote: Its only known skeleton comes from a subadult, with a small size of 1.5 m.

facts.statement: Trinisaura was a lightly built, bipedal dinosaur with long legs for running and a rigid tail for balance.
facts.quote: Trinisaura was very lightly built and bipedal, with long legs built for running and a rigid tail to aid in balance during locomotion.

facts.statement: Trinisaura exhibited a slower growth rate, likely an adaptation to the colder Antarctic climate.
facts.quote: Trinisaura is also noted to have a slower growth rate than genera that lived in warmer climates, an adaptation to colder temperatures of the Antarctic.

facts.statement: Trinisaura evolved distinct traits due to geographic isolation after Antarctica broke off from Gondwana.
facts.quote: During Trinisaura's existence, Antarctica had just recently broken off from the rest of Gondwana, causing it to evolve distinct traits due to geographic isolation.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a semi-articulated partial skeleton including vertebrae, an incomplete pelvis, a right humerus, and a partial right hindlimb.
facts.quote: The fossils come from a small ornithopod, consisting of a semi-articulated partial skeleton including several vertebrae (backbones), incomplete pelvis, fragmentary scapulacoracoid, right humerus, and a partial right hindlimb.

facts.statement: Additional fossils, including a left scapulacoracoid and more vertebrae, were identified in 2019.
facts.quote: Later, however, more fossils including the left scapulacoracoid and additional vertebrae were noted to be known in 2019.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is cataloged as MLP-III-1-1 at the Museo de La Plata.
facts.quote: The ornithopod specimen was then deposited at the Museo de La Plata under catalogue number MLP-III-1-1, later the holotype

facts.statement: A 2022 analysis by Karen Poole found Trinisaura in the Rhabdodontoidea clade rather than in Elasmaria.
facts.quote: However, a 2022 phylogenetic analysis by Karen Poole of the ornithischian groups Iguanodontia and basal Neornithischia found no Elasmaria clade, instead with Trinisaura in a branch of Rhabdodontoidea containing the Patagonian genera Talenkauen and Anabisetia and the South African genus Kangnasaurus.

facts.statement: Trinisaura was a herbivore with a long tail for balance, lithe hindlimbs, and short forelimbs.
facts.quote: Based on the phylogenetic position of the genus within Elasmaria and the known material, Trinisaura was herbivorous, lightly built, with a long tail for balance in addition to lithe hindlimbs and short forelimbs.

facts.statement: Trinisaura had a short dorsum with an avian sternum, an elongated neck, and a small, beaked skull adapted for eating plants.
facts.quote: The dorsum was short with an avian sternum and the neck was elongated, terminating in a small, beaked skull adapted for herbivory.

facts.statement: The humerus of Trinisaura is described as gracile and laterally bowed, though it is fragmentary.
facts.quote: The humerus is fragmentary, missing the proximal and distal ends, but is gracile and laterally bowed.

facts.statement: The ilium of Trinisaura is slender, low, elongate, and has a dorsally sigmoid outline, traits shared with most basal ornithopods.
facts.quote: The ilium is slender, low, and elongate, a trait shared with most other basal ornithopods, with a dorsally sigmoid outline.

facts.statement: The right femur of Trinisaura is the most robust limb element, featuring a thick shaft and wide expansions at both ends for articulation.
facts.quote: The right femur is the most robust of the limb elements, with a thick shaft and wide expansions at the proximal and distal ends for articulation with the pelvis and tibia.

facts.statement: A 2020 study analyzed the growth rates of Trinisaura and Morrosaurus using histological samples from their holotype long bones and third metatarsals.
facts.quote: In 2020, a study was conducted on the growth rate of Trinisaura, and its relative Morrosaurus, through use of histological study of thin samples from the holotype long bones and third metatarsal.

facts.statement: Histological studies found that Antarctic elasmarians like Trinisaura exhibited growth patterns similar to their South American relatives.
facts.quote: The study confirmed this pattern in elasmarians, with comparison to the South American elasmarian Gasparinisaura finding incredibly similar histology to the Antarctic genera.

facts.statement: Trinisaura is part of a clade of ornithopod dinosaurs that links continents formerly part of Gondwana.
facts.quote: The discovery of Trinisaura was concurrent with the first evidence of a previously hypothesized uniting clade of ornithopod dinosaurs from the continents that had comprised Gondwana.

facts.statement: Trinisaura and Morrosaurus provide evidence of dinosaur ties between Antarctica and South America.
facts.quote: The recognition of Morrosaurus and Trinisaura as Antarctic elasmarians closely related to animals from South America constituted important evidence of such ties existing in dinosaurs on these continents as well.

facts.statement: The discovery of Trinisaura challenges the traditional view of southern continents as refugia by showing connected endemic ecosystems during the Cretaceous.
facts.quote: These discoveries of connected endemic Gondwanan ecosystems have overturned the traditional view of the southern continents, acting as a refugium for animals more successful elsewhere earlier in the Cretaceous.

facts.statement: Trinisaura lived approximately 72 million years ago during the late Campanian stage of the Early Cretaceous in what is now Antarctica.
facts.quote: Trinisaura santamartaensis es la única especie conocida del género extinto Trinisaura de dinosaurios ornitópodos que vivieron a principios del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 72 millones de años, durante el Campaniense en lo que ahora es la Antártida.

facts.statement: In 2013, the formation was reported as early Maastrichtian, approximately 70 million years old.
facts.quote: En 2013 la formación se ha informado como del Maastrichtiense temprano, hace unos 70 millones de años.

facts.statement: Remains of a small euornithopod were found in Antarctica by Rodolfo Aníbal Coria and Juan José Moly in 2008.
facts.quote: En 2008, Rodolfo Aníbal Coria y Juan José Moly encontraron los restos de un pequeño euornitópodo en la Antártida.

facts.statement: The type species Trinisaura santamartaensis was described and named in 2013 by Coria, Moly, Reguero, Santillana, and Marenssi.
facts.quote: La especie tipo Trinisaura santamartaensis fue descrita y nombrada en 2013 por Coria, Moly, Marcelo Reguero, Sergio Santillana y Sergio Marenssi.

facts.statement: The specific name refers to Caleta Santa Marta, a cave on the northeast coast of James Ross Island where the specimen was excavated from the surface in hard sandstone.
facts.quote: El nombre específico hace referencia a la Caleta Santa Marta, una cueva en la costa noreste de la isla James Ross donde el espécimen fue excavado en la superficie, enterrado en arenisca dura.

facts.statement: The holotype, MLP-III-1-1, was found in the Snow Hill Island Formation, which dates to the late Campanian, about 72 million years ago.
facts.quote: El holotipo , MLP-III-1-1, se encontró en la Formación Snow Hill Island que data del Campaniense tardío, de unos 72 millones de años.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a partial skeleton lacking a skull.
facts.quote: Consiste en un esqueleto parcial sin cráneo.

facts.statement: The specimen was partially articulated.
facts.quote: El espécimen estaba parcialmente articulado.

facts.statement: The specimen belongs to an immature individual and is part of the collection at the Museo de la Plata.
facts.quote: Pertenece a un individuo inmaduro y forma parte de la colección del Museo de la Plata.

facts.statement: The holotype is a partial skeleton of a subadult individual about 1.5 meters long, with adults potentially reaching 2 meters.
facts.quote: El holotipo, MLP-III-1-1, consiste en un esqueleto parcial que carece del cráneo, de un individuo subadulto de cerca de 1,5 metros de longitud, un ejemplar adulto podría haber alcanzado unos 2 metros.

facts.statement: It was likely bipedal and relied on speed and agility to avoid predators.
facts.quote: Probablemente era bípedo y dependía de la velocidad y la agilidad para evitar a los depredadores.

facts.statement: A unique autapomorphy is the scapula's lower front edge projection, the acromial process, which ends in a sharp spike-like point with a strong, sharp comb on the outside and is relatively longer than in any other known euornithopod.
facts.quote: Uno de ellos es una autapomorfia, una característica derivada única, la escápula tiene una proyección en el borde frontal inferior, el proceso acromial, que termina en una punta afilada en forma de espiga, esta tiene un peine fuerte y afilado en el exterior y es relativamente más largo que cualquier otro euornitópodo conocido.

facts.statement: The humerus has a vestigial deltopectoral crest reduced to a bump on the front exterior.
facts.quote: El húmero tiene una cresta deltopectoral que es vestigial y se reduce a una protuberancia en el frente exterior.

facts.statement: The humerus shaft bends strongly outward.
facts.quote: El eje del húmero se dobla fuertemente hacia afuera.

facts.statement: The ischium bends gradually downward along the entire length of the shaft.
facts.quote: El isquion se dobla gradualmente hacia abajo en toda la longitud del eje.

facts.statement: The only found dorsal vertebra comes from the rear of the back and is quite damaged.
facts.quote: La única pieza de vértebra dorsal encontrada proviene de la parte posterior de la espalda y está bastante dañada.

facts.statement: The sacral vertebrae are robustly built and slightly flattened transversely.
facts.quote: Las vértebras sacras son de construcción robusta y algo aplanadas transversalmente.

facts.statement: The chevrons are flattened transversely at their ends and slightly widened front-to-back, with the hemal canal closed at the top.
facts.quote: Los cheurones están aplanados transversalmente en sus extremos y ligeramente ensanchados de adelante hacia atrás, el conducto hemal está cerrado en la parte superior.

facts.statement: The scapula shows a pointed acromion at the front.
facts.quote: El omóplato muestra un acromion puntiagudo en la parte delantera.

facts.statement: The preserved length of the humerus is 112 millimeters.
facts.quote: El húmero tiene una longitud conservada de 112 milímetros.

facts.statement: The metacarpals are elongated with triangular upper surfaces divided into two cusps by a median groove.
facts.quote: Los metacarpianos son alargados con superficies superiores triangulares, divididos en dos cúspides por un surco mediano.

facts.statement: Trinisaura is classified as an ornithopod dinosaur within the Neornithischia suborder.
facts.quote: regnum: Animalia phylum: Chordata classis: Sauropsida superordo: Dinosauria ordo: Ornithischia subordo: Neornithischia infraordo: Ornithopoda genus: Trinisaura

facts.statement: Trinisaura is known only from the Gamma Member of the Snow Hill Island Formation on James Ross Island, near the northeastern edge of the Antarctic Peninsula.
facts.quote: Trinisaura is known solely from the Gamma Member of the Snow Hill Island Formation in James Ross Island, an island in the James Ross Island group on the northeastern edge of the Antarctic Peninsula.

facts.statement: The floral composition, habitat, and climate were similar to modern volcanic arches.
facts.quote: The floral composition, habitat, and climate are of one similar to modern volcanic arches.

facts.statement: Fossil weathering and abrasion indicate minimal transport, reworking, and subaerial exposure before burial.
facts.quote: Trinisaura's fossils bear some surface weathering and abrasion, which indicate that they went through minimal transport, reworking, and subaerial weathering.

facts.statement: Trinisaura fossils show little to no signs of scavenging, unlike some contemporaries.
facts.quote: Trinisaura found alongside other dinosaurs with little to no signs of scavenging; Trinisaura itself is clean of scavenging.

facts.statement: The environment may have included wet areas similar to peat bogs, evidenced by peat mosses, clubmosses, and other plant groups.
facts.quote: Some of the environment may have been wet and similar to peat bogs, as evidenced by the presence of Sphagnaceae (peat mosses) and several other groups including the clubmoss Selaginella, the firmoss group Lycopodiaceae, and the clade Ericaceae.

facts.statement: The ilium of the pelvis is elongated, low, and has a wavy upper edge.
facts.quote: En la pelvis, el ilion es alargado y bajo con un borde superior ondulado.

facts.statement: The iliac blade is half the length of the ilium.
facts.quote: El ala es la mitad de la longitud.

facts.statement: The pubic bone appendage is shaped like a tip projecting forward and downward.
facts.quote: El apéndice del hueso púbico tiene la forma de una punta que sobresale hacia adelante y hacia abajo.

facts.statement: The pubis is thin, with a prepubic process shaped like a rod having a round cross-section rather than a flattened one.
facts.quote: El pubis es delgado, el proceso prepúbico tiene forma de varilla con una sección transversal redonda en lugar de aplanarse transversalmente.

facts.statement: The ischium curves downward and inward.
facts.quote: El isquion se dobla hacia abajo y hacia adentro.

facts.statement: The femur is robust, straight when viewed from the front, and inclined forward when viewed from the side.
facts.quote: El fémur es robusto, recto en vista frontal, inclinado hacia adelante en vista lateral.

facts.statement: A long fourth trochanter, with a nearly horizontal lower part and a gradual upper leg style, is located on the upper half of the posterior margin of the shaft.
facts.quote: El cuarto trocánter largo, cuya parte inferior es casi horizontal y la parte superior forma un estilo de pierna gradual, se encuentra en la mitad superior del margen posterior de la diáfisis.

facts.statement: The lower part of the femur is strongly widened.
facts.quote: La parte inferior del fémur está fuertemente ensanchada.

facts.statement: The anterior groove between the lower articular cusps is notably shallow, a basal feature, while the posterior groove is deep and wide.
facts.quote: El surco anterior entre las cúspides articulares inferiores es notablemente poco profundo, una característica basal, pero el surco posterior es profundo y ancho.

facts.statement: There is no trace of fusion with the ankle bones.
facts.quote: No hay rastro de fusión con los huesos del tobillo.

facts.statement: The lower part of the third metatarsal bone has parallel sides and is flattened from front to back.
facts.quote: La parte inferior del tercer hueso metatarsiano tiene lados paralelos y está aplanada de adelante hacia atrás.

facts.statement: The first phalanx of the third toe has the usual robust shape with the top and bottom widened.
facts.quote: La primera falange del tercer dedo tiene la forma robusta habitual con la parte superior e inferior ensanchadas.

facts.statement: The found phalanges of the fourth toe are solidly built, with the lower part slightly wider than the upper part.
facts.quote: Las falanges encontradas del cuarto dedo del pie están sólidamente construidas, con la parte inferior ligeramente más ancha que la parte superior.

facts.quote: Parent group: Elasmaria

facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia
